kaikki_vikisozluk.e: حَرْف جَرّ • (ḥarf jarr) m (plural حُرُوف جَرّ (ḥurūf jarr))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: "Particle of the genitive", composed of حَرْف (ḥarf, “grammatical particle”) + جَرّ (jarr, “genitive case”)
g: a particle that governs the genitive case in Arabic (loosely equivalent to preposition)
